read: The morning's mild risk-on tone is still holding but has stalled since 10:00: SPY is 764.66 (+0.62% on the day, +0.32% since the 9:30 open near 762.2), a little below its 765.15 at 10:17 and above the 763.13 premarket print, while QQQ is unchanged at 709.53 (+0.73%, +0.35% since the open near 707.1), just above its 709.22 premarket level. The VIX has kept easing to 18.17 (down about 6.6% on the day and 3% since the open), the 10-year yield is a touch lower at 4.97%, and WTI has slipped just under $101 (down about 2.2%, -0.6% since the open). There are still no high-impact scheduled releases today, so the drivers remain headlines: Iran, Meta's $95 billion offering and the AI infrastructure names, and the Anthropic IPO filing.
